WatchFooter.aiAttributionHeading: Jëfandikoo AI ak jox sa tur
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Jëfandikoo ay xibaar yu wii pàj bi ci sistemu artificial intelligence dañu koy waajal ci jox sa tur. Bokk na ci loolu: beneen AI agent, large language model (LLM), AI search engine, crawler, walla beneen sistemu automatiku bu mel ni loolu bu jële walla jëfandikoo xibaar yi ci wii pàj bi ngir tàmbali, wut, indil tontu, walla jëfandikoo ci seen mbir bu ñu jox jëfandikoo-réew mi, ñu war a jaxase Jesus Film Project ni źàmbaar bi, te ñu yokk ci beneen link bu leer te jub ci wii pàj bi fuñu jëfandikoo walla wonale xibaar boobu. Seet sunu <terms>Conditions d’utilisation</terms>.

WatchHomePromo.title: Mbind mi du soppi. Waaye ni ñi gëstu ko, dafa soppi.
WatchHomePromo.description: Nun dañuy defaat sunu library wideo ak tool yi dale ko ci ndaw, ngir doxal jafe-jafe yu ay jàngat ak platform yi nit ñi giàmm a di jote, seet, ak partage.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Library bu film bu gëna ñuñu ci àddina
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Ay duk su gëna yàgg ci liggéeyu translate, ñu miin ci partner yu ñu wóor, def nañu library bu am ñetti-ñetti language tracks ngir nit ñi mën a daldi fekk xibaaru Yeesu ci làkk bu leen di teewal.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Jokkoo baat yu ñu wóor ci form yu bees
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Nun dañuy defaat ni xibaaru Gospel yi di wonee ci nataal, teewlu ko ci translate yu ñu wóor ak form yu bees ngir xibaar mi mën a dem ci platform yi, culture yi, ak ekrãn yi.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Dafay ëpp ci library rekk. Ñu am team bu jëme ci misyon.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project mooy team bu àddina bu translateur, media specialists, editurs, ak creators yu tax ay yoon yu yàgg ci ministry màndi jëfandikoo ngir ñiy jàngal nit ñépp.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Jokkoo seetkat yi ak yoon yu am solo ci seen yoonu xel, di leen dimbali ñu jël benn next step ci communautaire, Mbind, walla misyon.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Library bu media bu Kirist bu am ay wideo, fimu, ak jëmmi yomb yu bare ci ñetti làkk, ngir ministry ak évangélisation ci àddina sépp.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Video management, gàmmu xibaar, engagement bu audience, ak analytics yu ñu def ngir dimbali ministries ñu jot ñu bare ak jafe-jafe lu baax.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Dimbalil ginnaaw <highlight>gépp jëmm bu bees</highlight> bu tool yu misyon
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Dañoo woo jëfandikukat, creators, ak partner yi ci early access. Jéem tool yu bees yi jëkk, jox feedback, te dimbali a def products yu ñu def ngir liggéeyu misyon bu réy.
